title: DONUTS accepts narrow valid regions that violate its FFT/background window bounds
summary: Category security; severity medium; confidence high; owner coordinator; open, nonblocking follow-up. indigo_libs/indigo_raw_utils.c:1237-1248 rejects only nonpositive include widths/heights. It then allocates projection vectors with length next_power_2(include_width/height) at1360ff and runs calibrate_re1206-1230. BG_RADIUS is5 at1072; calibrate_re unconditionally writes vector[0..5] and starts another edge-zeroing loop at size-5, independent of allocation length. Region width/height1–4 therefore produces a vector allocation of1/2/4 elements but out-of-bounds writes before FFT. For a length1 transform _fft:318-348 has only n==2 as the recursion base, so1 recurses through0 indefinitely. RGB projection filtering also indexes include_width-2/include_height-2 for a one-column/row region. These are valid positive region dimensions accepted by the public function and by agent_guider validate_include_region878-933; the DONUTS include-region path at998ff passes these values. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (MATH-1). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
